intent.proves: At least one login user has at least one profile sharing its username in the same shop.
intent.scope: non-group AccessUser rows with AccessUserIsLogin = 1 and other rows of the same username and shop

bindings.reason: Lookup by known usernames only; a census needs an enumeration handler.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser l WHERE l.AccessUserIsLogin = 1 AND l.AccessUserType <> 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AccessUser p WHERE p.AccessUserUserName = l.AccessUserUserName AND p.AccessUserId <> l.AccessUserId AND p.AccessUserType <> 2 AND ISNULL(p.AccessUserShopId,'') = ISNULL(l.AccessUserShopId,''))
